brief_item.title: 远程内存感知的数据库算子缓冲区优化
brief_item.core_conclusion: 远程内存每轮传输引入固定RTT使磁盘溢出启发式失效，REMOP用传输轮次感知的缓冲区划分降低溢出查询运行时。
brief_item.mechanism: 为连接、排序、哈希算子推导输入输出缓冲区划分，最小化总延迟L=D/BW+C·RTT。
brief_item.result: 块嵌套循环连接运行时降48.7%、传输轮次减97.1%，TPC-H溢出查询均降22.7%。
brief_item.boundary: 仅两节点测试床，无生产数据，RDMA有软件开销与页粒度失配。
brief_item.project_relevance: 暴露远程内存传输轮次成本结构并量化数据搬移开销，但未涉及DSA或IAA卸载。

facts.title: REMOP: REmote-Memory-aware OPerator Optimization
facts.event_hint: REMOP framework for remote-memory-aware database operator optimization
facts.problem: Classical disk-spilling operator heuristics minimize I/O volume but can trigger excessive transfer rounds under remote memory where each round incurs fixed RTT, making total latency sensitive to round count
facts.mechanism: Transfer-round-aware intra-operator buffer partitioning strategies; derives operator-specific input/output buffer splits for blocked nested-loop join, external merge sort, and external hash join to minimize total latency L = D/BW + C*RTT

evidence.claim: REMOP reduces transfer rounds by up to 97% and operator runtime by up to 48% on spill-heavy microbenchmarks
evidence.condition: BNLJ single-operator query, selectivity f=1/256K, memory budget M=4K pages, two-node compute-memory testbed

evidence.claim: REMOP reduces BNLJ runtime by 48.7% and transfer rounds by 97.1% at L-optimal buffer settings
evidence.condition: BNLJ with (rin=0.4, pR=0.6), selectivity f=1/256K, M=4K pages

evidence.claim: REMOP lowers average runtime of spilling TPC-H queries by 22.7%
evidence.condition: TPC-H spilling queries, two-node compute-memory testbed

evidence.claim: REMOP lowers average runtime of spilling TPC-DS queries by 26.4%
evidence.condition: TPC-DS spilling queries, two-node compute-memory testbed

evidence.claim: REMOP achieves gains up to 51% under higher remote-memory latency

facts.evaluation_context: Two-node compute-memory testbed; DuckDB implementation; TCP-based REMON and RDMA-based Infiniswap backends evaluated; microbenchmarks for BNLJ, EMS, EHJ; end-to-end TPC-H and TPC-DS spilling queries
facts.limitations: Testbed evaluation only; no production deployment data; RDMA backend (Infiniswap) shows software overhead and page-granularity mismatch that can diminish raw RDMA advantage; model assumes fixed budget M and does not address dynamic memory redistribution across concurrent queries; RTT parameter tau proportional to BW*RTT must be estimated for deployment
facts.project_relevance: Topic alignment strong (内存语义、DSA卸载: remote memory/disaggregated memory semantics). REMOP addresses memory resource semantics by exposing transfer-round cost structure of remote memory swapping—directly addressing how memory tier changes latency characteristics. Demonstrates端到端收益传导: operator-level microbenchmark gains (48% runtime reduction, 97% transfer-round reduction) propagate to TPC-H (22.7%) and TPC-DS (26.4%) query-level improvements. No DSA/IAA offload focus, but quantifies CPU/data-movement cost of remote memory semantics through RTT-dominated cost model.

facts.title: SK hynix at FMS 2026: V10 375-layer 4D NAND and Next-Generation Memory Architecture for AI
facts.event_hint: SK hynix FMS 2026 showcase of its first wafer-bonded 375-layer 4D NAND (V10) wafer and NAND server-memory products for AI, August 4-6 2026, Santa Clara.
facts.problem: AI training, large-scale inference and Agentic AI drive exponentially growing data volumes, demanding higher density and lower-power NAND tiers; no single memory product can meet combined bandwidth and capacity needs, motivating a Tiered Memory architecture (HBM/DRAM/NAND(HBF)/SSD).
facts.mechanism: 375-layer 4D NAND built with wafer bonding (SK hynix's first NAND product to apply wafer bonding) for high performance plus low power; 1Tb TLC devices offered in a 2-Channel 32-Die Package (first TLC to support it) and a smaller-footprint 334B QDP package; positioned as a NAND/HBF tier between HBM and SSD for AI data centers.

evidence.claim: SK hynix displayed a 375-layer 4D NAND Wafer, its first NAND product to apply wafer bonding, delivering both high performance and low power consumption across device environments including AI data centers.
evidence.condition: Exhibit wafer shown at FMS 2026 'The Smart Edge' zone
evidence.source_locator: Section 'From AI Accelerators & Servers to Edge Devices: A Comprehensive Memory Portfolio' / The Smart Edge - '375-layer 4D NAND Wafer'

evidence.claim: The 375-layer 1Tb TLC 154B 32DP is the first TLC-based product to support a 2-Channel 32-Die Package.
evidence.source_locator: Section 'From AI Accelerators & Servers to Edge Devices' - '375-layer 1Tb TLC 154B 32DP'

evidence.claim: The 375-layer 1Tb TLC 334B QDP improves space efficiency with a 13.5x12.5mm footprint versus a conventional 4-Channel Package at 14x18mm.
evidence.source_locator: Section 'From AI Accelerators & Servers to Edge Devices' - '375-layer 1Tb TLC 334B QDP'

evidence.claim: The QLC-based PS1101 high-capacity eSSD lineup delivers about 55% higher performance than the previous 176-layer generation, and sample shipments to major CSP customers begin in August 2026.
evidence.condition: QLC eSSD, developed sequentially by form factor
evidence.source_locator: Section 'From AI Accelerators & Servers to Edge Devices' - PS1101 eSSD lineup paragraph

facts.evaluation_context: FMS 2026 exhibition, Santa Clara Convention Center, August 4-6 2026. Facts are booth product displays and vendor-stated specifications, not benchmark results. Keynote framed Tiered Memory (HBM, DRAM, NAND(HBF), SSD) for Agentic AI; SK hynix delivered 12 Technical Sessions including 'Why, What, How HBF?' and an HBF panel with Google and Sandisk.

No absolute sequential/random bandwidth (GB/s, IOPS), P/E endurance, write amplification, access latency, or cost/bit numbers appear in the visible evidence.

brief_item.title: KV缓存全球分发系统的愿景框架
brief_item.direction_name: KVCache感知的网络与带宽调度
brief_item.core_conclusion: 模型侧和系统侧KV缓存优化在传统云边界内独立演进阻碍计算与存储的最优放置，本文提出KV缓存互联网愿景使网络成为带宽感知的内容分发通道。
brief_item.mechanism: 全局控制平面含目录、放置规划与预取调度，支持随处存储与带宽感知迁移。
brief_item.result: 1GB KV缓存在10Gbps链路上比8xB200集群计算快约19倍、成本低约5.2倍。
brief_item.boundary: 愿景论文无实现，未给TTFT/TPOT/P95，未建模控制平面开销。
brief_item.project_relevance: 提出网络作为KV缓存分发通道，但缺具体TTFT/TPOT与状态感知调度对比。

facts.title: An Internet for the KV Cache: Rethinking Classical Infrastructure Boundaries in the LLM Inference Age
facts.event_hint: A UChicago position paper (Ray, Feamster, Jiang) argues KV-cache reuse has turned LLM inference into an internet-scale content-distribution problem and calls for decoupling KV-cache storage from compute across cloud/datacenter boundaries, with the network as an active distribution channel.
facts.problem: Model-side advances that shrink the KV cache and system-side advances that reduce compute/storage/transfer costs evolve independently within legacy cloud boundaries; today's cloud economics bind storage to compute, so moving KV-cache state across zones, regions, or clouds becomes a dominant expense even when transfer would be cheaper and faster than recomputation.
facts.mechanism: A proposed 'Store Anywhere, Use Everywhere' content-distribution architecture for KV cache: a global control plane (KV Cache Directory, Lookup Service, Placement Planner, Prefetch Scheduler) places compute and KV-cache nodes by jointly optimizing (a) model metrics (prefill FLOPs, KV-cache size), (b) infrastructure metrics (GPU cost, storage cost, network bandwidth), and (c) application metrics (reuse frequency, tool-call duration, request turns). Reuse horizons drive tiering: seconds->hot (near GPU), minutes->warm, hours->cold; unlike CDN data, KV caches can be regenerated, so store/load/prefetch/partial-fetch/recompute/evict decisions become adaptive.

evidence.claim: Recomputing a 1 GB KV cache on an AWS 8xB200 GPU cluster takes ~15s and costs $0.47, making transfer of that 1 GB KV cache over a fully utilized 10-Gbps link ~19x faster and ~5.2x cheaper than recomputation.
evidence.value: ~15s and $0.47 to recompute 1GB KV cache; transfer ~19x faster and ~5.2x cheaper over 10-Gbps link
evidence.condition: Fully utilized 10-Gbps link; 1 GB KV cache
evidence.source_locator: PDF Page 2: 'AWS 8xB200 GPU cluster takes ~15s and costs $0.47, making transferring the 1 GB KV Cache over a fully utilized 10-Gbps link ~19x faster! and ~5.2x cheaper.'

evidence.claim: The placement of compute and KV-cache nodes should be determined by a function of model-specific metrics (prefill FLOPs, KV-cache size), infrastructure-specific metrics (GPU cost, storage cost, network bandwidth), and application-specific metrics (reuse frequency, tool-call duration, number of turns).
evidence.value: joint placement function over model + infrastructure + application metrics
evidence.source_locator: PDF Page 2 (Our Vision): 'The placement of compute and KV Cache nodes is determined by a function of a) model-specific metrics, like prefill FLOPs and KV Cache size; b) infrastructure-specific metrics, like GPU cost, storage cost, and network bandwidth; and c) application-specific metrics, like reuse frequency, tool-call duration, and number of turns in a request.'

evidence.claim: KV-cache reuse is highly heterogeneous along the time domain: in agentic workflows the same cached context may be reused after seconds, minutes, or hours, creating reuse horizons longer than a single generation's latency and enabling tiered storage (seconds->hot near GPU, minutes->warm, hours->cold/farther).
evidence.condition: Agentic workflows with multi-step tool calls
evidence.source_locator: PDF Page 5 (Figure 1) and PDF Page 5: 'KV Cache decisions: store / load / prefetch / partial fetch / recompute / evict ... Reuse horizon: seconds -> store hot | minutes -> store warm | hours -> store cold' and 'KV Cache reuse is highly heterogeneous along the time domain ... KV Caches with near-term reuse can remain close to the GPU, while KV Caches with longer reuse horizons can be pushed to cheaper and farther storage tiers.'

evidence.claim: Unlike data in traditional CDNs, KV caches can be regenerated; the optimal location depends not on administrative boundaries but on the storage-network-recompute tradeoff induced by future reuse, so the network becomes an active distribution channel whose bandwidth, latency, and pricing directly determine how the KV cache should be managed.
evidence.value: KV cache regenerable; placement driven by storage-network-recompute tradeoff
evidence.condition: Vision model, not a measured system
evidence.source_locator: PDF Page 5: 'Unlike data in traditional CDNs, KV Caches can be regenerated ... Its optimal location depends not on administrative boundaries, but on the storage-network-recompute tradeoff induced by future reuse.'

facts.evaluation_context: This is a vision/position paper ('call for arms'), not a measured system. The single quantitative result is a back-of-envelope cost/latency comparison for a 1 GB KV cache on an AWS 8xB200 cluster vs. a 10-Gbps transfer link (PDF page 2). The paper surveys model-side optimizations (MoE, sparse attention), KV-cache optimizations (CacheBlend, Cache-Craft, EPIC, TurboQuant, KVzip, RocketKV), and system-side optimizations (DistServe, Sarathi-Serve, Mooncake, WindServe) to motivate the architecture, and references prior cloud-transfer cost studies. No prototype, no measured TTFT/TPOT/throughput/end-to-end P95 numbers are provided.
facts.limitations: Position paper only: no implementation, control plane, or prototype evaluation is included; all architecture and metrics are proposed, not measured. No end-to-end latency, throughput, bandwidth-utilization, or KV-cache-transfer-byte results. The single cost figure (~15s, $0.47, 19x/5.2x) is a static back-of-envelope calculation for one cache size and link speed, not a benchmark. JS/TS, multi-tenant fairness, and privacy/isolation across clouds are not addressed.
facts.project_relevance: Directly frames the cross-region / KV-cache-distribution thesis central to the cross-region topic: it argues that once KV-cache reuse is common, the WAN cost is justified by a 5.2x cost and 19x latency win over recomputation for large caches, and that reuse horizons (seconds to hours) make tiered, bandwidth-aware KV-cache placement the right abstraction. Useful as architectural motivation, not as measured evidence.
source_notes: Primary source: arXiv:2608.01526v1, Ray, Feamster, Jiang (UChicago), 2 Aug 2026; document.fetch_status=FETCHED.

Low quality score reflects that this is a vision/position paper with one back-of-envelope quantitative figure and no measured system; most claims are architectural arguments rather than verified experimental facts.
